profileSummary.text: Fullstack developer with 1+ year building meeting-processing and IoT products. Builds APIs and web and mobile interfaces, and fixes production issues.

employmentBullets: Built the recording upload and progress-feedback flows for Sensio Notes (Node.js, React) across web and mobile, including recovery after interrupted uploads.

Implemented UI/UX designs as web and mobile features and integrated with the services of the AI and IoT engineers.
Debugged production issues and supported testing and releases with the infrastructure and security engineers.
